name: 79928 · Horizon City, TX
findings: ZIP 79928 (Horizon City) has 54 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 79928 (Horizon City) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
